text:
amanda: Quick heads-up — PR #4821 turned red in CI: only integration/payment_flow failed on ubuntu-22. Run: https://ci.redwood.com/runs/234567

raj: Looks like a flaky external timeout. We can try a minimal rerun of that job without rebuilding images.

amanda: Sweet. What's the exact command? I don't have perms to rerun.

raj: Use the internal CLI for a focused rerun:
```
# rerun single job, skip rebuilding docker images
redwood-ci rerun --run 234567 --job integration/payment_flow --no-image
```
Or with GH CLI if you want to rerun the whole workflow (no fine-grain job pick):
```
gh run rerun 234567
```
If you suspect the test image itself is corrupted, rebuild only the image:
```
redwood-ci rebuild --run 234567 --job integration/payment_flow --only-image
```

leo: FYI --no-image preserves the existing test image digest (fast). --only-image will rebuild the image but not trigger test jobs (useful when image layers are the suspect).

amanda: I don't have write perms here. @taylor can you trigger the minimal rerun?

taylor: Sure, kicking it off now.

ci-bot: Rerun started for run 234567 job integration/payment_flow — triggered by taylor

taylor: Update — rerun finished: job passed :white_check_mark:

amanda: Awesome, thanks :raised_hands:

sre-oncall: Adding a short note to the incident board: transient external timeout, no escalation needed.

raj: I'll add a tiny flaky-test tracker entry linking run 234567 so we can watch recurrence.

amanda: Cool — closing the PR now.
